description: Search Regulations.gov public COMMENTS on rulemakings — the killer B2G dataset (who is lobbying which rule). Same JSON:API envelope + input shape as regulations_search_documents (searchTerm/query, agencyId, docketId, postedDateGe/Le, sort, pageNumber 1..40, pageSize 5..250) against /v4/comments. Returns { comments:[{ id, documentType, title, agencyId, docketId, postedDate, objectId }] } + honest _meta (same totalElements-exact total + 40-page/10,000-record ceiling handling as documents).

agencyId.description: Filter by posting agency acronym (filter[agencyId]), e.g. 'EPA', 'FDA'.

documentType.description: Filter by document type (documents only): Rule / Proposed Rule / Notice / Supporting & Related Material / Other.

pageNumber.description: 1-based page number, 1..40 (HARD cap — page[number] max is 40; the reachable window is 40×pageSize ≤ 10,000 records).

query.description: Alias for `searchTerm` (either is accepted; both feed filter[searchTerm]).

withinCommentPeriod.description: true ⇒ only documents currently open for comment (documents only; filter[withinCommentPeriod]).

name: regulations_search_comments
